content: As part of Mission Pégase 26, the French Air and Space Force has deployed four Rafale F4 fighters, three A330 MRTT Phénix multi-role tanker transport aircraft and two A400M Atlas aircraft to Jodhpur

title: Omar Abdullah brings Statehood resolution in J&K Assembly amid loud protests by BJP MLAs
content: Reference to 2002 autonomy report triggers protests by 29 BJP legislators in the Assembly as they tore the NC-backed resolution, stormed into the Well of the House and climbed onto tables forcing a brief adjournment

title: Hundreds of private bus workers yet to submit details for police verification

title: Government yet to decide how open-column caste data will be sorted, tabulated
content: Opposition parties and OBC groups are against the open-column option in the 2027 Census; they say the 2011 Socio-Economic Caste Census also had an open field to record caste, yielding over 46 lakh caste names; successive governments did not act on that report, says experts

content: Police probing the case said they had come across at least 25 complaints from different parts of the State against the firm

content: While some have started raising awareness about the ESA draft notification and the Kasturirangan report through social media, others are translating the material into Kannada

content: In their appeal, the four women wrestlers argue that the acquittal rests on 'archaic and stereotypical assumptions' about the expected behaviour of victims of sexual harassment and assault

title: Railway Ministry approves tri-weekly Amrit Bharat Express between Bhuj in Gujarat, Barauni in Bihar
content: “Train No. 19427 Bhuj-Barauni Amrit Bharat Express will depart from Bhuj at 5:30 p.m. and reach Barauni at 04:05 a.m.. In the return direction, Train No. 19428 Barauni-Bhuj Amrit Bharat Express will depart Barauni at 11.55 pm and reach Bhuj at :15 pm,” says a press statement from the Railway Ministry

content: The export-linked value chain is expected to provide better returns to farmers. According to APEDA, while the prevailing market price is around ₹60 per kg, farmers receive ₹82 per kg through the export-linked channel

title: Idukki to resume dismantling of illegal fences blocking elephant corridors
content: District Collector Dineshan Cheruvatt orders the dismantling of unauthorised structures that obstruct wildlife movement. Farmers’ groups and the church leaders demand withdrawal of order. Chief Minister says genuine farmers will face no trouble, and only encroached fences will be cleared.

content: The new judges are Justices Usharani, Kuruba Shanthappa Bharath Kumar and Nerale Veerabhadraiah Bhavani

content: Tourism destinations should undergo audits, while stakeholders should be trained in disability-friendly practices, say speakers at the seminar

content: The 1958 law gives power to Army and Central Armed Police Forces deployed in ‘disturbed areas’ to kill anyone acting in contravention of law, arrest and search any premises without a warrant

content: The member argued that the social media post contained only a political observation comparing media coverage of political leaders’ foreign trips across different tenures

content: Awards are presented in four categories and are aimed at recognising and encouraging rural and women entrepreneurs’ contribution to income generation and employment across villages and small towns

title: Muttil tree-felling case: Keralam Forest dept. resubmits chargesheet after correcting errors
content: The latest submission comes amid allegations that the earlier chargesheet was weak and that the omissions could have benefited the accused, the Augustine brothers

title: Karnataka hikes PG course fees in government first-grade colleges by 10% for 2027-28
content: The fee for MSc courses in Computer Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology and Information Science, excluding university fees, has been fixed at ₹8,720. The fee for the MCA course has been fixed at ₹11,720

title: Why Trump's F-35 deal with Saudi Arabia unsettles Israel, opens big door for China
content: Under the deal, the state department has notified Congress of a possible sale of 48 jets, with engines and support, which would make Saudi Arabia the second country in the Middle East to fly the aircraft after Israel. The Saudi jets will reportedly not have all the advanced features of the F-35s operated by Israel.

title: UP polls: Why Akhilesh’s ‘rath’ show in Raebareli is message for Rahul
content: The Samajwadi Party's election campaign in Uttar Pradesh has been launched by Akhilesh Yadav, amid escalating conflicts with Congress over seat-sharing negotiations. Each party is eager to highlight their recent electoral achievements in their pursuit of power. Given the historical missteps that led to failed alliances, there are worries about potential pitfalls. To counter the BJP's significant influence, collaboration between both parties is crucial.

title: Chess Olympiad R9: Gukesh channels his world champion self to keep India in gold hunt
content: D Gukesh produced a crucial comeback win over Germany’s Alexander Donchenko in Round 9, helping India stay in the Chess Olympiad gold medal race. India’s men beat Germany 2.5-1.5, while Vantika Agrawal and Divya Deshmukh powered the women’s team to victory. India’s men trail Uzbekistan, while the women remain second behind leaders China with two rounds left.

title: Zuckerberg’s $300m superyacht docks in Japan, gets neighbour who once wanted Meta out
content: Mark Zuckerberg's impressive superyacht, Launchpad, has recently anchored in Japan, right beside Yusaku Maezawa's Nausicaä. Their close proximity underscores an ongoing legal dispute as Maezawa pursues Meta for the misuse of his name in deceptive investment advertising. Even without plans to meet, their vessels symbolize the intense rivalry. After a summer in Alaska, Launchpad is set to chart its course towards Singapore, making this encounter noteworthy.

title: Michigan family lost $194,400 home over $2,242 tax bill; Supreme Court steps in
content: The United States Supreme Court has made a landmark decision stating that tax sale compensation must be based on the auction price rather than the assessed value of a property. A family in Michigan, burdened with a $2,241.93 tax debt, faced foreclosure despite their home being valued at $194,400. With the auction yielding only $76,008, the family is rightfully awarded the remaining $73,766.07, reinforcing constitutional guidelines for future tax sales.

title: Mumbai prime home prices rise 6.2%, enter global top 10
content: In a striking development, Mumbai has surged into the world’s top 10 residential markets, landing at eighth place with a notable 6.2% annual price gain. Bengaluru and New Delhi aren't far behind, securing the 12th and 17th spots. While global prices ticked up by only 2.6%, Mumbai's luxury segment stands resilient, fueled by high demand and limited housing options in prime locales.

title: Nebraska couple lost $59,759 home over $588 tax debt; compensation claim revived
content: A Nebraska couple, Kevin Fair and Terry Fair, lost their home due to unpaid property taxes totaling $588. After being unable to pay the amount required to redeem their property, Continental Resources obtained a tax deed. Fair claimed that losing property worth $59,759 for such a small tax debt constituted an unconstitutional taking. The Nebraska Supreme Court ruled Fair had a valid takings claim based on property value.

title: NASA sent 12.5 million tomato seeds to space; later planted across 40,000 schools
content: In 1984, NASA initiated the SEEDS project aimed at exploring how the space environment affects plant growth. Participants, comprising approximately 3.3 million students from diverse educational backgrounds worldwide, received kits that included seeds launched into space and Earth-based controls for comparison. Preliminary findings indicated a marginally enhanced germination rate for the seeds sent to space, though notable growth differences diminished during the plants' life cycles.

title: Peter Thiel to everyone blaming China for anti-AI backlash in America: Stop doing this
content: Peter Thiel believes that the growing anti-AI sentiment in the US is primarily due to domestic factors. He acknowledges potential influence from China but labels it as not the main cause of concern. Thiel criticizes the AI encyclical by Pope Leo XIV, claiming it may foster negative perceptions in the US. Additionally, he argues that the US should scrutinize its own discussions regarding AI's role in society.

title: Georgia landowner claimed $23m tax break; court backs $480,000 valuation
content: A Georgia landowner claimed a $23 million charitable tax deduction after donating a 103-acre conservation easement, arguing the property could have been used as an aggregate quarry. The US Tax Court rejected the proposed quarry use, valuing the easement at $480,000. The 11th Circuit upheld the valuation and a 40% gross valuation misstatement penalty.

title: The lesbian bar outrage shows why Donald Trump won America
content: One was oddly remindedof Onoda after coming across the Boston ‘lesbian bar story’ that is every product manager’s wet dream: a story published in the Boston Globe that went so viral that it led to over a thousand  subscriptions for what seemed a rather nondescript story but is an elegant outpost of woke America’s lastbastion.

title: India is kicking car safety into top gear with Bharat NCAP 2.0: What you need to know
content: Bharat NCAP is set to evolve with its second phase, Bharat NCAP 2.0, planned for October 2027. This revised framework will assess vehicle safety across multiple stages, including crash avoidance and post-collision care. The new system promises to go beyond just occupant protection to include vulnerable road users as well. Adult and child occupant protection will remain critical components of the evaluation process.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo's wife Georgina Rodríguez builds Mimoa activewear brand
content: Georgina Rodríguez is expanding her fashion career with Mimoa, a premium activewear and lifestyle brand focused on comfort, movement and everyday wear. Drawing on her experience in fashion, Rodríguez has developed collections featuring leggings, tops, jackets and sweatshirts designed to move beyond the gym. Mimoa also reflects her personal approach to body confidence, while helping her build an independent business identity beyond her connection to Cristiano Ronaldo.

title: Who is Tommy “Gun” McMillen? Meet UFC’s 12-0 featherweight prospect
content: Tommy 'Gun' McMillen is building his reputation in the UFC featherweight division with an undefeated record. He began his combat sports journey at a young age, excelling in wrestling and boxing. McMillen has won all three of his UFC fights, showcasing his striking and finishing abilities. He broke a UFC record for significant strikes landed in a three-round fight during his bout with Alberto Montes.

title: Called ‘black-complexioned’ and ‘fatty-shaped’: Why man’s divorce plea failed
content: A husband in Chhattisgarh appealed for divorce from his wife due to claims of cruelty and desertion. The high court examined the evidence and found the husband's allegations lacked proof. The court noted that inappropriate comments alone did not justify granting a divorce. Additionally, the wife provided counterclaims against her husband’s behavior and care. Consequently, the court upheld the family court's decision and dismissed the divorce appeal.

title: Haaland's Man City face expulsion threat: Club found guilty on 114 financial charges
content: City, who are currently top of the Premier League after five matches in the 2026 season, were charged by the league in February 2023 following an investigation into alleged financial rule breaches between 2009 and 2018. The club has consistently denied any wrongdoing throughout the process.

title: Trump gives 'totally unacceptable' warning to Xi over China helping Iran
content: Donald Trump told Xi Jinping that any assistance China provides to Iran is unacceptable during his visit. The two leaders held a closed-door meeting to discuss various critical global issues, including trade and military matters. Trump organized a state dinner attended by key US technology executives to enhance relations. The visit coincided with China's Mid-Autumn Festival, marking a time for family gatherings and festivities.

title: 'Glaciers, floods don't travel with visas': Nepal PM's India-China appeal
content: In his maiden address to UN General Assembly, Shah, 36, said, “Glaciers and floods do not travel with a visa stamped on passports.” His address on Thursday came during his first foreign trip since taking office on March 27.

title: Massive fire at Delhi building housing Haldiram’s outlet; 30 rescued
content: A fire broke out in a three-storey building in northwest Delhi's Model Town area. The incident occurred around 2pm, with thick smoke seen billowing from the building. After a swift police response, around 30 people were safely evacuated from the premises. The Delhi fire service deployed 23 units to control the medium fire, which started due to a suspected short circuit.

title: Asian Games: India win six medals, including shooting gold, as Baranica makes history
content: During a thrilling day at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, India brought home six medals, showcasing its athletic prowess. Baranica Elangovan made waves as she bagged a bronze medal in women's pole vault, a historic first for the nation. In shooting, Suruchi Singh and Kamaljeet delivered a sensational performance, earning gold and ending a lengthy wait for that accolade.

title: The Backstory: When 'Tau' Devi Lal won the PM race, and then gave it away
content: Emerging as a pivotal political leader during the 1989 governmental shift in India, Chaudhary Devi Lal first captured the deputy Prime Minister position via astute maneuvering within the Janata Dal party. His major influence was rooted in unwavering backing from Haryana's agricultural sector. Yet, infighting ultimately led to the VP Singh government's downfall.

title: Baranica Elangovan wins India's first-ever pole vault medal at Asian Games
content: The 29-year-old secured the bronze with a best clearance of 4.15m. She shared the medal with Kazakhstan's Polina Ivanova, who also cleared 4.15m. The two athletes matched each other on countback, resulting in a shared bronze.

title: PM deepfake pics case: HC orders removal of content, police protection for woman
content: The Delhi high court has directed the removal of deepfake content involving a woman's morphed photographs. This content allegedly associates her with Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a protest by the Cockroach Janta Party. The court issued notices to the Delhi Police and CJP leaders following an urgent plea. Furthermore, the court ordered police protection for the woman, who has faced threats.

title: Defence minister felicitates expedition crew summitting 20 unclimbed peaks in Ladakh
content: In a momentous ceremony, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh honored a mountaineering team that reached a groundbreaking summit. Over 23 days, the team conquered 20 previously untrodden peaks soaring above 6,000 meters in Ladakh. Led by Col Ranveer Singh Jamwal from the National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports, Dirang, their remarkable feat emphasizes India's strength in mountaineering and enhances its stature on the global stage.

title: 'Stop contesting polls': CJP's 'fixed match' msg to oppn parties amid SIR row
content: Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, challenges opposition parties to stop participating in rigged elections. He argues that continuing to contest gives legitimacy to flawed electoral processes. Dipke highlights that such participation undermines democracy and fears for political survival. His comments follow multiple instances where election commissioners objected to decisions of the Election Commission. Dipke even proposed a further agitation if his demands regarding election integrity are ignored.

title: From Ukraine to Africa, drone dog fights now a reality
content: The proliferation of attack drones is prompting militaries worldwide to develop drone interception technologies. Ukraine has become a primary testing ground for interceptor UAVs and innovative technologies. Other nations, including the United States and India, are developing advanced counter-drone systems to address emerging threats. The ongoing arms race in drone technology continues to evolve rapidly with new developments.

title: Balapur’s famous Ganesh laddu fetches record Rs 39L as visarjan festivities peak
content: During the Ganesh Visarjan celebrations, the auction of the Balapur Ganesh laddu achieved a record bid of Rs 39 lakh. Sam Praneeth Reddy from Vanasthalipuram won the prestigious laddu after competing against eight bidders. The tradition of auctioning the laddu began in 1994, with initial bids starting as low as Rs 450. The revenue generated is utilized for Ganesh Puja celebrations and community development programs.

title: 'Don’t touch this Vijay, you'll regret it': TN CM targets DMK ahead of bypoll
content: Addressing a massive gathering after a grand reception in the constituency,  Vijay accused the DMK of resorting to abusive language out of desperation.

title: Asian Games: India's medal tally hits 20; Manush, Diya win mixed doubles TT bronze
content: The Indian pair lost their semifinal to China's Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha 8-11, 5-11, 8-11, 2-11, but finished on the podium with a bronze medal.

title: ‘Gun nikal’: Delhi victim recounts how rapists took turns, held knife to her neck
content: A 17-year-old girl experienced a disturbing incident on her birthday inside Aastha Kunj Park. After visiting Kalkaji Mandir, she and her friend were approached by three men claiming to be police officers. The men allegedly assaulted the girl at knife point in various locations within the park. After the attacks, they threatened her and her friend to remain silent about the incident.

title: BJP Leader's Son Stays Back To Save Mother In Noida Bus Fire. Both Die
content: Sunita and Shashank, wife and son of Mahoba BJP District Treasurer Neeraj Gupta, were among those who died in the fire. The family lived in the Rajmandir area of Charkhari town.

title: Man's Crowdfunding Drive For Sister's Surgery Went Viral. She Doesn't Exist
content: The man, identified by police as Ajayveer Singh, posed as 16-year-old Jay Singh Rathore and appealed on X for financial help for his younger sister, claiming she was at risk of losing her eyesight.

title: Why Balen Shah Never Takes Off His Iconic Dark Sunglasses, Even At The UN
content: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah is particular about when and how to wear his sunglasses. He keeps them on during parliament sessions, public ceremonies, military parades and while taking photographs with foreign ambassadors.

title: "Stalin Sir, Open Your Mouth": Vijay Attacks DMK In Veeramani Sex Abuse Case
content: Though a complaint had been lodged during the previous DMK regime, the entire crime and its history was buried, Vijay alleged.

content: Five people were injured in the incident and have been hospitalised. Police action has been taken against the driver.

title: High Court Asks Meta To Remove Woman's Morphed Images, CJP Leaders Get Notices
content: The High Court ordered social media giant Meta to remove all objectionable pictures and links related to the woman from its platforms within 24 hours.

title: Diljit Dosanjh, Khali Back Campaign To Save Punjab Trucker On Death Row In Saudi Arabia

title: Opinion: Opinion | Is The World Staring At A Big Stock Market Crash - And Recession? 5 Uneasy Signs
content: On Wednesday, the US bond market recorded its worst day since Trump's "Liberation Day" tariffs rattled markets in April 2025. The 30-year US Treasury yield topped 5.43%, putting it on track for its highest close since 2004.

title: Punjab Man Who Took Poison In Anti-Drugs Protest Faces 9 Cases Himself

title: In 1st Joint Op, Finland, Sweden Deploy Jets To Intercept Russian Aircraft
content: The Baltic Sea region, of which the Gulf of Finland is part, is on high alert after incidents involving gas pipeline outages, airspace violations and drone sightings since Russia's 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

title: "Won't Speak Today": Kerala Chief Minister VD Satheesan Sidesteps Questions On Chopper Row
content: Satheesan on Wednesday said the government's contract with a helicopter company for emergency travel had expired. Moreover, he had underscored that his air dash to Malappuram "did not burden the public exchequer".

content: On September 17 and 18, 2024, thousands of pagers and hundreds of hand held walkie-talkies exploded in multiple locations across Lebanon, paralysing Hezbollah operations as many reported severe injuries.

content: If a bank offers a lower loan rate when insurance is purchased, the proposed framework would allow the customer to buy insurance from any insurer.

content: Billionaires like Elon Musk and Sam Altman, among others, have already thrown their support behind these orbital data centres, aiming to harness near-continuous sunlight to power energy-intensive AI computing.

title: 'Compromised PM does it again': Cong after bail to US national held in terror case
content: the release of US national Matthew Aaron vanDyke has triggered a political row . he was arrested by the NIA in a case involving an alleged terror conspiracy linked to Myanmar-based ethnic armed groups . the accused had entered India and travelled to restricted areas in the northeast before crossing into Myanmar .

title: Air India pilot found tipsy just before operating Zurich-Delhi flight, suspended
content: the pilot found tipsy before operating a Zurich-Delhi flight . he was found unfit to operate the same and till alternate crew was arranged . the airline has asked it to improve its checks and balances .

title: ‘Gyanesh Kumar deserves at least Padma Bhushan’: Bengal BJP chief backs CEC
content: BJP chief says he deserves 'at least the Padma Bhushan' for overseeing peaceful elections . he also took a swipe at Congress leader Rahul Gandhi . the BJP leader said voters were able to cast their ballots without fear .

title: NDA unease over EC-SIR row? 3 BJP allies seek answers as oppn turns up heat
content: three BJP allies urge the Election Commission of India to issue a clearer response . a report concerning chief election commissioner gyanesh Kumar surfaced on friday . the BJP president was the first NDA ally to urge the ECI to dispel "misgivings in the minds of the people"

title: Watch: PM Modi grooves at a 'bhajan clubbing' event in Delhi
content: the prime minister attended a 'bhajan clubbing' at deen dayal Upadhyay Park . he can be seen listening to the Bhajans while playing the headless tambourine . the PM also waved to the gathered audience as he arrived for the event .

title: 'Could endanger his life': Imran Khan's son warns against Adiala jail protest
content: imran Khan's son urges supporters not to march towards a jail protest . he warns against a "counter" assault on the prison and put his father's life at risk . the former prime minister has been in prison since august 2023 .

title: Trump assassination attempt victim James Copenhaver dies at 76
content: copenhaver was injured when a gunman opened fire at his campaign rally . his cause of death was not disclosed . the 76-year-old died on friday at a hospital, his family says .

title: ‘Nothing to do with SIR row’: EC on postponement of CEC's UP outreach events
content: the election commission clarifies that the postponement of chief election commissioner's youth outreach events in Uttar Pradesh had nothing to do with the ongoing row over alleged internal differences in the poll body . a number of factors were necessiated due to logistical factors such as availability of venues, schedules of higher authorities and natural factors .

title: 'A terrorist country is asking me': Jaishankar's sharp reply to Pak journalist
content: "a terrorist country is asking me that question. Come on," jaishankar said in response to the journalist's question . the journalist stood up and asked, "when will your government stop sponsoring terrorism in Pakistan?" the exchange came a day after an Indian journalist had put Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on the spot as he entered the building .

title: 17.17m and onto the podium: Manpreet Kaur wins shot put bronze at Asian Games
content: the 36-year-old became only the third Indian woman to win an Asian Games medal in women's shot put final at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya . her personal best is 18.06m that came in 2022 . she returned to the podium after more than a decade at the senior level .

title: ‘What was the deal?’ Vijay takes aim at DMK over Veeramani child rape case
content: chief minister: "something truly atrocious is happening right now" he says a person has been exploiting Tamil Nadu's young girls and children for years . the matter and its history were quietly buried, sir .

title: Asiad: Gulveer races into 10,000m silver; India's athletics surge continues
content: long-distance runner Gulveer Singh won the men's 10,000m silver medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya on friday . he clocked 28:29.38 to complete the run, 1.87 seconds behind the gold medalist Birhanu Balew of Bahrain . the gold came a day after Seema Kumari won bronze in the women's 1000m race .
